svg.title: Examblue Performance Coach production roadmap
svg.desc: Offline textbook ingestion feeds MongoDB Atlas Vector Search. At runtime a student request goes through Cloud Run, the ADK agent retrieves top-3 chunks and student data, then a LiteLLM router calls a fine-tuned LLM with a Gemini or Groq fallback.
svg.text: Chunks tagged: grade, subject, topic, page
